The upstream tag 'latest' is a MOVING tag and its releases/latest REST pointer may be hijacked by newer archive releases (entware-go issue #71): this manifest pins the exact asset bytes observed at verification time; any upstream republish invalidates it and requires a new reviewed manifest version.

The upstream release also carries mihomo_1.19.34-3_x64-3.2.ipk (16065944 bytes, sha256 0b9b4b6d5a9010ecaf07048c87e6cbc14c469d122b625f237861493b78078652); it is deliberately out of the router mirror scope, same as in the reviewed 1.19.34-2 snapshot.
